integrity: Standalone certificate checker verifies explicit finite witnesses. The all-r result follows from the symbolic proof; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only cyclic groups of squarefree order with at least five distinct prime factors.
All-r result is a cycle-coverage upper bound, not an exact circumference theorem at ranks at least eight.
Exact lower cycle-cover witnesses have been checked for ranks five, six and seven only.
Independent historical-priority and mathematical audit have not been performed.
title: A central-layer obstruction to cyclic subgroup-factorization chains
